text.en:
The fiscal year for all branches, subdivisions, instrumentalities, departments, bureaus, offices,
and agencies of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines, including government-owned or
controlled corporations, shall be the period beginning with the first day of January and ending with the
thirty-first day of December of each calendar year.

The fiscal year herein prescribed shall take effect on January first, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.

The fiscal year which begins on July first, nineteen hundred and seventy-five and ends on June
thirtieth, nineteen hundred and seventy-six is hereby extended to include the six-month period from July first
to December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
Appropriate budgetary provision for minimum essential operating requirements for the said six-month period
shall be made by proper authorities concerned. Provided, That such provision shall not exceed fifty per cent
(50%) of the programmed or actual current operating expenditures of the agency or entity for the immediately
preceding twelve-month period. Provided, Further, that the current and capital requirements for the said six-
months period shall be submitted to the Development Budget Coordination Committee (DBCC) not later than
March 31, 1976, for its approval.
Accounting and financial records, reports, and statements shall accordingly be rendered to reflect the extended
coverage of the immediately preceding fiscal period.

The Chairman, Commission on Audit, the Secretary of Finance, and the Commissioner of the
Budget shall promulgate such rules and regulations as may be necessary to implement the provisions of this

All laws, executive orders, administrative orders, ordinances, resolutions, rules and regulations,
or parts thereof which are inconsistent with this Decree are hereby repealed or amended accordingly.
Done in the City of Manila, this 24th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
